Parameter.name: TaskName
Parameter.Description: This defines the user-visible name of this task; This is defined in subclasses.

Method.name: OnTask
Method.Description: The OnTask() method is called to execute the task

Method.name: CheckSvnSetup
Method.Implementation:
NEW $NAMESPACE SET $NAMESPACE = "ITFCOMMON"
IF ' ##class(%File).DirectoryExists(direc) { set fStat = ##class(%File).CreateDirectoryChain(direc) set svnCmd = $$$SVNCHECKOUT _ " --username " _ userNm _ " --password '" _ passwd _ "' " _ $$$SVNSETTINGURL _ " " _ direc Set status = ##class(IHC.ITF.SrcCtrlPkg.EnsembleSrcCtrlClass).ExecuteShellCmd( svnCmd) Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFileWithUserNm($USERNAME, $$$SVNCHECKOUT _ " as " _ userNm _ "- status: " _ status)
if (($$$ISERR(fStat)) || (status '= 0)) { set tSC = $$$ERROR($$$GeneralError, $$$SVNCHECKOUT _ " failed for user: " _ userNm _ ", SVN URL:" _ $$$SVNSETTINGURL _ " to" _ direc) Quit tSC } }
set svnCmd = $$$SVNUPDATEALL _ " --username " _ userNm _ " --password '" _ passwd _ "' " _ direc Set status = ##class(IHC.ITF.SrcCtrlPkg.EnsembleSrcCtrlClass).ExecuteShellCmd( svnCmd) Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFileWithUserNm($USERNAME, $$$SVNUPDATEALL _ " as " _ userNm _ "- status: " _ status)
Quit $$$OK
